the synthesis of dextrin-containing hydrogels by enzymatic acylation and subsequent polymerization.

the enzymatic synthesis of dextans is a promising method for the preparation of biodegradable hydrogels.

dextran-containing polymers can be prepared in a facile way using biocatalytic approaches and the polymers can be used as a matrix for hydrogel formation.
